notes: Build92 restores one canonical local-first Command Composer with PLAN and BUILD modes. PLAN delegates to the Local Agent in no-write plan mode. BUILD permits automatic read tools but stops at waiting_approval for every write proposal. The canonical client generates a read-only diff preview through repo.patch_preview or repo.read_file, rejects stale write_file proposals, and approval requires an explicit UI action bound to taskId + proposalDigest. Cancellation is exposed once a task handle exists. No LD2_BUILD_EXECUTE/LD2_PLAN_APPLY legacy shortcut, no direct Tool Runtime write, no automatic approval and no legacy chat are activated. Attachments remain disabled until Build93.
